speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease.

The clinical presentation of a unilateral resting tremor progressing to affect fine motor tasks (reading), combined with recent memory decline in a 70-year-old male, is highly suggestive of Parkinson's disease, likely with early cognitive involvement.
